correctness.rationale: For the specified six A2 root frequencies and Haar-probability torus measure, Parseval on P_c^3 yields 216 ordered triples, 37 occupied sums and sum_nu |T_nu|^2=2040, hence J(u)=2040/216=85/9. Independently rebuilt both exact rational 6x6 second-order matrices directly from integer triple incidence and obtained Hx eigenvalues 340/3 (radial), -77/3, -68/3 (twice), -65/3 (twice); Hy eigenvalues 0 (three), -15, -27 (twice). Explicit infinitesimal phase and translation vectors span all three zero eigenmodes. The radial mode is not tangent to the unit sphere, so all orbit-normal directions are strictly negative and the greatest normal eigenvalue is -15. Smooth tubular coordinates and a least-stable imaginary normal vector give a strict local maximizing orbit and exact limiting squared-distance deficit 15. The theorem expressly does not claim global maximality in arbitrary coefficients.
